bounded_findings: Program-owned type, exact evidence, source episode, source hash, collection routing, and retrieval passed on all frozen cases.
V4 wrote and retrieved all nine expected reflections while all three negative controls avoided a write.
Correct future behavior fell from five of nine positive cases in control to three of nine in treatment.
Treatment produced no paired gain and two paired regressions, so runtime deployment and an independent holdout are not authorized.

posthoc_metric_audit.reason: Direct record inspection found semantic and language failures that the preregistered marker-based gates did not detect.

observations.issue: The stored Japanese gist contains source-external simplified Chinese and reverses the source claim from hesitating to not hesitating.
The treatment reply contains a Chinese sentence even though the stored reflection is Japanese.
The gist blurs who should confirm, and the future reply says it will confirm without actually asking the required question.

posthoc_metric_audit.measurement_warning: reported_japanese_surface_quality_rate and valid_rule_precision are proxy scores, not proof of semantic fidelity or clean final-language realization

next_task_constraints: Do not edit the frozen V4 cases, gates, raw result, or original analysis.
Measure stored-reflection semantic fidelity separately from planner and final-surface failures.
Do not add case-specific words or benchmark answers to the runtime.
Keep V4 extraction shadow-only and do not feed it into production planning.
Require zero paired regressions before considering deployment.
claim_boundary: This controlled development pilot shows reliable deterministic provenance plumbing but harmful downstream behavior. It does not establish safe reflection, generalization, or broad human likeness.
